name: Joy Bangla Concert 2018 (4th edition)
organizer: Young Bangla / Centre for Research and Information (CRI)
notes: Fourth edition, eight bands, free entry. More than 32,000 people registered online for the event — the largest documented registration figure in this dataset and a useful measure of the scale a free, state-adjacent rock festival could reach at the end of the 2010s. Registration is not attendance; the figure is recorded here as reported demand, not as a headcount. Billing labels beyond Artcell's closing slot are approximate.
